data.title: REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES makes app not complaint with Google Play Policies
data.body:
Currently, I have a problem when pushing an app to the Play Store. Due to the fact that the library uses the 
REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES permission, the app gets rejected. 

The attribute "tools:node=remove" in the manifest file has been removed from the "uses-permission" element. Previously, this was the only solution to remove the permission. I cannot seem to find an up-to-date solution anywhere.

The core use of the app does not require the permission and I would like to know how to remove the permission or how I can get Google to approve the app.

If this is really a new issue, then thank you for raising it. I will investigate it and get back to you as soon as possible. Please, make sure you have given me as much context as possible! Also, if you didn't already, post a code example that can replicate this issue.

In the meantime, you can already search for some possible solutions online! Because this plugin uses native WebView, you can search online for the same issue adding `android WebView [MY ERROR HERE]` or `ios WKWebView [MY ERROR HERE]` keywords.

Following these steps can save you, me, and other people a lot of time, thanks!
